lines.en: label futabapokex:
scene futabadten8
with dissolve
: A-A-A-A-A-Arousal?! No no no no no! That's not what's happening at all!
lines.zh: : 兴——兴——兴奋？！不不不不不！根本不是那么回事！

lines.en: : Just because I zoned out...thinking about you with...your...no!
lines.zh: : 就算我走神了……想着你和你的……不对！

lines.en: : That's not even remotely close to what's getting into me!
lines.zh: : 那跟我现在的状况差了十万八千里！

lines.en: : It's not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! Not even close! Not even {i}almost{/i} close! You're so far off that...it's not even funny!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！差远了！连{i}接近{/i}都算不上！你离谱到……一点都不好笑！

lines.en: : Oh.
: Then I guess I'm alone in feeling that way.
lines.zh: : 那看来只有我一个人是这种感觉了。

lines.en: : You're...what?!
: Did you really expect me to be able to see you in {i}that{/i} and not react in this way?
lines.zh: : 你真以为我看到你{i}那样{/i}还能没有反应吗？

lines.en: : At the very least, I didn't expect you to come out and just admit it! We're-
lines.zh: : 至少我没想过你会直接承认出来！我们是——

lines.en: : Student and teacher, right? Is that what you were going to say?
lines.zh: : 学生和老师，对吧？你是想说这个？

lines.en: : Well, what else am I supposed to say in this position?!
lines.zh: : 那我在这个立场上还能说什么？！

lines.en: : Here I am being super embarrassed about how I look and...you’re busy thinking weird things and completely ignoring that!
lines.zh: : 我这儿正为自己这副样子难为情得要死……你倒好，只顾着想些奇怪的事，完全无视！

lines.en: : You were thinking weird things too, though. And you said them out loud well before I did. I'm just following your example.
lines.zh: : 可你也在想奇怪的事啊。而且你比我更早说出口。我只是照你的样子学而已。

lines.en: scene futabadten10
with dissolve
: It's...different when I say those things about you!
lines.zh: : 我说你那些话的时候……可不一样！

lines.en: : How, though?
lines.zh: : 哪里不一样？

lines.en: scene futabadten11
with dissolve
: B...Because...everyone thinks you're really handsome and stuff...and you're probably used to people...fantasizing about you...
lines.zh: : 因……因为……大家都觉得你很帅什么的……你大概早就习惯别人……对你抱幻想了……

lines.en: : That's...not a thing I've ever realized someone would actually do about me before...
lines.zh: : 这……我还从没意识到真的会有人对我做这种事……

lines.en: : If...you {i}are{/i} actually doing that and...aren't just messing around with me right now...
lines.zh: : 如果……你{i}真的{/i}在做那种事，而不是……现在在拿我寻开心的话……

lines.en: : How many times do I have to tell you how attractive you are before you start believing me?
lines.zh: : 我要说多少次你很有魅力，你才会开始相信我？

lines.en: : It's not...really that easy to just {i}believe,{/i} Sensei...It's a lot more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 要{i}相信{/i}真的没那么容易，Sensei……事情比这复杂得多。

lines.en: : I'm sure it is, but I'm going to abuse my position right now and exercise my power as your teacher to command that you listen to me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不过我现在要滥用一下职权，行使我作为你老师的权力，命令你听我的。

lines.en: scene futabadten8
with dissolve
: Are you...commanding me to be aroused?!
lines.zh: : 你是在……命令我兴奋起来吗？！

lines.en: : No. I am commanding you to accept {i}my{/i} arousal without question.
lines.zh: : 不。我命令你无条件接受{i}我的{/i}兴奋。

lines.en: scene futabadten10
with dissolve
: That's just as bad! In fact...no! That's even worse!
lines.zh: : 那一样糟！不……等等！那更糟！

lines.en: This is fun.
lines.zh: 真有趣。

lines.en: scene futabadten11
with dissolve
: I miss the old, non-perverted Sensei...This one is weird and...keeps saying weird things that...make me feel weird...
lines.zh: : 我怀念以前那个不色情的 Sensei……现在这个好奇怪……老是说些奇怪的话……让我也变得奇怪……

lines.en: For some strange reason, I'm beginning to think Futaba may be weirded out right now.
lines.zh: 不知为什么，我开始觉得 Futaba 现在可能被我吓到了。

lines.en: Maybe it's for the best if I back off a little?
lines.zh: 也许我稍微收敛一点比较好？

lines.en: Being too forward with a girl like her might just wind up scaring her away if I'm not careful.
lines.zh: 对她这种女孩太直白，要是不小心，搞不好会把她吓跑。

lines.en: And after seeing exactly what she has to {i}offer{/i} up close and not concealed by a blazer or a button-down, that is not something I am willing to risk.
lines.zh: 而在近距离看过她{i}拥有{/i}的东西——没有被西装外套或衬衫遮住的那种之后，这可不是我愿意去冒的险。

lines.en: : Okay, I'll stop. I didn't mean to make you-
lines.zh: : 好，我停下。我不是故意让你——

lines.en: scene futabadten8r
with dissolve
: Wait, no! I didn't mean it like that! I’m {i}glad{/i} you’re a pervert!
lines.zh: : 等等，不是！我不是那个意思！我{i}很高兴{/i}你是个色鬼！

lines.en: scene futabadten12
with dissolve
: Wait, what?! That’s not what I meant to say! Why did I say that?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！我不是想说这个！我为什么要说那种话？！

lines.en: : I'm just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene futabadten11
with dissolve
: I'm just...really surprised. That’s all...
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的很惊讶。就这样……

lines.en: : I know that boys are generally interested in...breasts and stuff...so I can understand that...{i}reaction{/i} from you...
lines.zh: : 我知道男生一般都对……胸部什么的感兴趣……所以你那种{i}反应{/i}我能理解……

lines.en: : I know mine are...on the bigger side...
lines.zh: : 我也知道我的……偏大……

lines.en: They are not just {i}on the bigger side.{/i} They have their own fucking team.
lines.zh: 那可不只是{i}偏大。{/i}它们他妈的都能自成一队了。

lines.en: : But that’s just because...I’m a little...overweight...
lines.zh: : 可那只是因为……我有点……偏胖……

lines.en: : So it’s not like they’re...particularly...alluring or anything...
lines.zh: : 所以它们也算不上……特别……诱人什么的……

lines.en: scene futabadten10
with dissolve
: Ahhh! What am I saying?! And why aren’t you stopping me?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我在说什么啊？！你为什么不拦着我？！

lines.en: : Because you're cute, that’s why.
lines.zh: : 因为你可爱啊，就是这个原因。

lines.en: : And I like you the way you are.
lines.zh: : 而且我喜欢你现在的样子。

lines.en: scene futabadten13
with dissolve
: Well...you have weird tastes then...because I don't see myself that way at all...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你的品味真奇怪……因为我完全不觉得自己是那样……

lines.en: The two of us stand there in silence for a few seconds as Futaba begins to awkwardly look around the room.
lines.zh: 我们俩沉默地站了几秒，Futaba 开始尴尬地环顾房间。

lines.en: She’s probably nervous that Rin will walk in on this and get the wrong idea or something.
lines.zh: 她大概是担心 Rin 会撞进来，误会了什么。

lines.en: Well...
Would it even count as “getting the wrong idea” here? Because it’s pretty obvious what this conversation has evolved into and Rin would very likely be getting the {i}right{/i} idea.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这算得上「误会」吗？这场对话演变成了什么再明显不过，Rin 大概会得出{i}正确{/i}的结论。

lines.en: scene futabadten11
with dissolve
: H-Hey...Can I...ask you something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿……我能……问你个问题吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sure. But if it involves how you don't think you're attractive again, I'm probably going to hit you.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过要是又涉及「你觉得自己不好看」那一套，我大概会揍你。

lines.en: : Lightly, of course. But I'll do it.
lines.zh: : 当然只是轻轻地。但我会动手。

lines.en: scene futabadten13
with dissolve
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I just want to know why you've been spending so much time with me lately...
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，你最近为什么花这么多时间陪我……

lines.en: : Do I really need a reason to spend time with you? Can't I just do it because I want to?
lines.zh: : 我陪你真的需要理由吗？我不能只是因为想这么做吗？

lines.en: : Of course, but...{i}why{/i} do you want to?
lines.zh: : 当然可以，可是……你{i}为什么{/i}想呢？

lines.en: : I'm...not as pretty as the other girls...or exciting...or even charismatic.
lines.zh: : 我……没有别的女孩漂亮……也不有趣……更没有什么魅力。

lines.en: : I just don't get why it seems like...you've been seeking {i}me{/i} out when so many better options exist...
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白，明明有那么多更好的人选……你为什么看起来一直在找{i}我{/i}……

lines.en: : Because I like to, Futaba. It's that simple.
lines.zh: : 因为我喜欢，Futaba。就是这么简单。

lines.en: : And I know that’s probably not something I should be saying or doing at my age, but it’s the truth.
lines.zh: : 我知道以我这个年纪，这话大概不该说、这事大概不该做，但这是事实。

lines.en: scene futabadten14
with dissolve
Futaba doesn’t answer me right away.
lines.zh: Futaba 没有立刻回答我。

lines.en: Instead, her eyes navigate to the floor and locate a smile somewhere along the way.
lines.zh: 她的目光落到地板上，途中不知在哪里捡到了一个微笑。

lines.en: It crawls onto her face like a spider, replacing the crooked frown of uncertainty that stood there just seconds ago.
lines.zh: 它像蜘蛛一样爬上她的脸，取代了就在几秒前还挂在那里的、不安的扭曲愁容。

lines.en: It’s a sincere smile- one that appears to have melted away all the bits and pieces of uneasiness in her body.
lines.zh: 那是一个真诚的微笑——看起来把她体内所有细碎的不安都融化了。

lines.en: It’s a smile all for me.
lines.zh: 那是只为我而生的微笑。

lines.en: I burn it into my retinas so that I may look back on it each time I close my eyes.
lines.zh: 我把它烙进视网膜，好让每次闭上眼睛都能重新看见。

lines.en: : You’re...really cool...
lines.zh: : 你……真的很酷……

lines.en: : I'll probably never understand why you keep choosing to hang out with {i}me{/i} of all people...but I guess I have to respect your decision when you put it like that...
lines.zh: : 我大概永远都不会明白，那么多人里你为什么总挑{i}我{/i}……不过你都这么说了，我想我得尊重你的决定……

lines.en: scene futabadten15
with dissolve
: And I’m...really sorry for acting strange tonight.
lines.zh: : 还有……真的很抱歉我今晚表现得很奇怪。

lines.en: : The conversation just went in...a direction I wasn't prepared for and...I didn't know how to handle it.
lines.zh: : 对话就这么……走向了我没准备好的方向……我不知道该怎么应对。

lines.en: : I’d really like it if you...kept coming here, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……我真的希望你……以后还能常来……

lines.en: : Because...I really like spending time with you too, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 因为……我也真的很喜欢和你待在一起，Sensei……

lines.en: scene futabadten14
with dissolve
: Like...{i}A lot...{/i}
lines.zh: : 是……{i}非常喜欢……{/i}

lines.en: scene futabadten15
with dissolve
: But...as much as I like it...I think you should probably head home before things...head in {i}another{/i} direction I'm not really prepared for.
lines.zh: : 不过……尽管我很喜欢……我觉得你大概该回去了，免得事情……走向{i}另一个{/i}我还没准备好的方向。

lines.en: : Do you think they would if I stayed around?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我要是留下来，事情会变成那样吗？

lines.en: : I'm not sure...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……

lines.en: : Lately...nothing really seems to be going the way I expect it to.
lines.zh: : 最近……什么事都不太按我预想的发展。

lines.en: : So...I guess anything is really possible as long as I'm with you.
lines.zh: : 所以……我想只要和你在一起，什么都有可能发生。

lines.en: : And that's just a little scary to think about.
lines.zh: : 光是想想就有点可怕。

lines.en: : Well, I don't want to scare you. So I'll head out now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不想吓到你。那我现在就走。

lines.en: : I’ll definitely be back, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我一定会再来的。

lines.en: : And hopefully, whatever happens next time won't make you think any less of me.
lines.zh: : 希望下次不管发生什么，都不会让你看轻我。

lines.en: : I'm sure it won't. You openly admitted to...f...fantasizing about me tonight and...that didn't make me think of you any less.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会。你今晚都坦白承认……对……对我抱幻想了……那也没有让我看轻你。

lines.en: : Cool. Because I'm planning on doing a little more of that as soon as I get home.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为我打算一回家就再多幻想一点。

lines.en: : I'm...going to ignore that you just said that and thank you again for stopping by, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我……当我没听见你刚那句，再次谢谢你过来，Sensei。

lines.en: : Have a good night.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: : You too, Futaba...
lines.zh: : 你也一样，Futaba……

lines.en: scene black
with dissolve2
: See you soon.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: Tonight...went well?
lines.zh: 今晚……算是顺利吧？

lines.en: Sure, now I’ve got to walk home concealing an erection, but I definitely feel like Futaba and I have somehow strengthened our {i}friendship.{/i}
lines.zh: 好吧，现在我得遮着勃起走回家，但我确实觉得，我和 Futaba 之间的{i}友谊{/i}算是加深了。

lines.en: Maybe even to the point where it's starting to morph into something a little more than that.
lines.zh: 甚至可能到了开始变成比友谊更多的东西的地步。

lines.en: I hope that whatever cuts its way through the cocoon is as beautiful as she is.
lines.zh: 但愿从茧里破出来的东西，和她一样美。
